Hi all —

Quick finance checklist to speed recognition once PO arrives:
- Required PO fields: legal entity name, PO number, bill-to address, invoice recipient email, SOW reference or contract ID, payment terms, and total amount in USD.
- If PO is consolidated (single line item referencing the contract total) we can process a single invoice on PO receipt and recognize bookings in the same period — ideal for quarter tracking.
- If PO contains milestone line items with separate acceptance conditions, revenue recognition will follow milestone delivery unless the PO explicitly waives milestone acceptance terms.
- For AP/preferred terms: net-30 is standard; net-45 will not block processing but may impact cash timing.
